body:
# [Y] Apocalypse Zombies

This Mod adds brand new Zombies straight out of the Apocalypse!

## There's many new Types of Zombies:

- Base Zombie: A slightly weaker version of the regular Zombie, but he has a lot of friends.
- Rusher: The Rusher is not only small and fast, but he also has a special move which allows him to catch up to any target that runs too far.
- Tank: The Tank is not to be underestimated. With his heavy punches he can eliminate any player that dares to come too close. Unfortunately, he is a prominent leg day skipper, so he's not the fastest on his feet.
- Infected: The Infected carries the Disease very potently as he's only just become a Zombie. If he attacks you, you might just succumb to the infection as well.

### This Mod is still in Alpha Development. Features may not work properly.
